name: HEXIND
recent: Hextar Industries 拟以 1.7748 亿令吉收购 Woodpeckers Group 51% 股权的交易，因先决条件未能在期限内达成，已于 2026 年 9 月 11 日失效。公司另有多项提案及关联方交易公告，并持续进行股份回购。
notable: 拟以 1.7748 亿令吉收购 Woodpeckers Group 51% 股权的交易，因先决条件未达成而失效。
公司发布多项提案公告。
公司根据 CA 2016 第 127(16) 条发布股份回购公告。
risks: 拟议收购 Woodpeckers Group 51% 股权的交易已失效，交易不会进行。
earnings: 2026 年 6 月 30 日止季度营收为 3.5732 亿令吉，环比增长 52.2%，同比增长 27.2%；净利为 1298 万令吉，同比增长 95.6%，净利率为 3.6%，高于上一季度的 -2.8%。

recent_en: Hextar Industries' proposed acquisition of a 51% stake in Woodpeckers Group for RM177.48 million lapsed on 11 September 2026 as conditions precedent were not fulfilled. The company also announced multiple proposals and a non-related party transaction, and continued share buybacks.
notable_en: The proposed acquisition of a 51% stake in Woodpeckers Group for RM177.48 million lapsed as conditions precedent were not fulfilled.
The company issued a share buyback notice under Section 127(16) of CA 2016.
risks_en: The proposed acquisition of a 51% stake in Woodpeckers Group has lapsed and will not proceed.
earnings_en: For the quarter ended 30 June 2026, revenue was RM357.32 million, up 52.2% QoQ and 27.2% YoY; net income was RM12.98 million, up 95.6% YoY, with a net margin of 3.6% versus -2.8% in the prior quarter.
